changelog: v42c is a FIX REVISION of v42b: after an Update Now restart the System Health 'Config Check' row showed 'unknown' until the first 4-hour check ran, because the runtime integrity check only ran at device boot or every 4 hours. The check now also runs right after every core start (boot AND update restarts), so the row shows its real result (ok / restored / error) within minutes of any update or HA restart; before the first run ever it reads 'waiting' instead of HA's error-lookalike 'unknown'. For the history: v42b fixed the row showing 'Entity not found' because Home Assistant pins an entity_id in its entity registry the first time a unique_id is seen -- renaming a sensor does not move a registered entity_id, so the sensor's unique_id was changed and every unit registers fresh as sensor.cytech_integrity_status (the id the row references); v42a was the earlier rename-only attempt that couldn't heal already-registered units. Units coming from v39 or older also get v42/v41/v40 below. v42 makes a corrupted configuration.yaml self-healing, and not just at boot: the system keeps a rolling known-good snapshot of configuration.yaml (refreshed after every clean check -- at boot and every 4 hours while running), and if the live file is ever found corrupt it is replaced by the snapshot with the broken copy saved as configuration.yaml.corrupt.<timestamp>, HA restarts (runtime corruption is repaired the same day it happens, before the next update's restart could land the system in HA recovery mode), and the integrity alert says so. Two safety properties: the snapshot is only refreshed after the configuration actually parsed clean, so a corrupted state can never be snapshotted as 'good'; and no restore happens unless the snapshot itself parses, so there is no restore loop. Integrity alerts are now also emailed (support@cytech.biz always, plus the owner's registered address per the v41 rule), and the System Health dashboard shows a Config Check row with the last running check result. For v39 or older, v42c also carries v40 and v41: the owner's address field is 'My Email for Alerts', a Register press always reports its status on screen (empty field: 'Enter your email first, then press Register.'), a successful Register sends ONE confirmation mail To: the owner Cc: support@cytech.biz, alerts ALWAYS go to support@cytech.biz with the owner's registered address copied automatically (no Cytech/Me/Both selector), and units with mail configured but no owner registered yet show a small non-blocking hint. Nothing is lost if the owner never registers: support@cytech.biz always receives every alert.
